title: Przez park, przez most
note: C1 Block 5, unit 2 - and the SECOND of the three units in this batch that OWES A ROW IN data/case-map.json. Three rows ship in this same commit (przez = through/across, przez = for-how-long, przez = the by-agent), per the standing instruction in codex/WHICH-CASE-DIGEST.md: c1_which_case [235] derives its table from that file and would otherwise be missing its own level. THE GOVERNOR IS THE UNIT. przez is verified NEW as a bare string (check_new.py, 196 live nodes) - unlike na, it is NOT a tooling artifact: przez appears in no multiword lemma anywhere in the course, so it is genuinely untaught and IS in teaches_lemmas. THE CASE IT TAKES IS ALREADY OWNED - the Accusative since a1_miec [9] - so the new thing is the trigger, not the ending. THE ANCHOR NOUNS WERE CHOSEN TO HIDE NOTHING: park, most and las are masculine inanimate and miasto is neuter, so none of them shows an ending, which is exactly the trap c1_na_acc hit one unit earlier. Slide 2 therefore runs the visible demonstration on two feminines - przez ulice and przez rzeke - where the -e is the same Accusative ending the learner has put on kawa since path 9. ulice and rzeke are the only two new NOUN forms in the pack and both are tagged, per the every-form-taught rule. THE VERBS PAY b2_motion_prefixes2's NAMED FENCE, in that pack's own words: it dropped prze- ENTIRELY because 'przejsc's everyday use is przejsc PRZEZ ulice, and przez is untaught: it is a preposition governing the Accusative, i.e. a whole new governor... Deferred: it needs either its own small slot after a przez unit, or C1.' This is that slot. przejsc and przejechac weld onto the two stem tables that pack already built (poszedlem -> przeszedlem, pojechalem -> przejechalem, pojade -> przejade), so each is ONE NEW WORD read off a mirror table, never derived - the b2_motion_prefixes2 idiom, held exactly. PERSONS ARE DELIBERATELY LIGHTER THAN b2_motion_prefixes2: 1sg and 3sg only, both genders in the past, no 2sg anywhere. That pack taught 11 forms per verb because the verbs WERE its new system; here the governor is, and the verbs are the payoff, so nothing beyond 1sg/3sg is taught and nothing beyond 1sg/3sg is used. FORK LOGGED, NOT SILENTLY TAKEN: C1-SPINE names wjechac for this unit. It is NOT built here. b2_motion_prefixes2 dropped it for a reason this unit does nothing to remove - 'the front piece changes shape between the two stems (we-/w-), which would be a THIRD irregularity' - and, decisively, wjechac is not a przez verb at all: its frame is wjechac DO garazu, do + Genitive, so it would import an unrelated prefix irregularity into a governor unit. przejechac was built in its place because it IS the przez partner of przejsc and completes the prze- row that pack dropped. C1 is the last level, so this is a permanent deferral unless James says otherwise - flagged loudly in C1-DIGEST batch 8. THE THIRD JOB (duration) COSTS ZERO NEW ENDINGS and was included for that reason: przez rok, przez tydzien, przez dwa lata, przez dwie godziny all reuse forms owned since A1/A2 - dwa lata is a2_numbers_gen's own 2-4 counted form and is verified TAUGHT as that. caly is the single new word it needs and it is used only on masculine time nouns (dzien, tydzien, rok), where the Accusative equals the dictionary form; no feminine or neuter form of caly is taught, shown or demanded. THE FOURTH JOB (the by-agent) IS NAMED AND KEPT SMALL: it rides b2_passive's OWN construction (X jest <participle>), with napisany/napisana TAUGHT <- b2_participle_pass [176], so the only new thing in List jest napisany przez tate is przez itself. zostac AND THE DYNAMIC PASSIVE ARE FENCED TO c1_zostac AND APPEAR NOWHERE HERE - no zostal, no zostanie, not in a table, a distractor or an aside. That is the whole reason C1-SPINE puts this unit three nodes ahead of that one. HOMOGRAPH DISCIPLINE, checked rather than assumed: mamy is NOT used anywhere (AGENTS names it - the verb 'we have', not the Genitive of mama); gory is NOT used (AGENTS names it - the plural 'mountains', not the Genitive of gora); lata was re-checked and is a2_numbers_gen's counted plural of rok, which is exactly the job it does here. szly and jechal are untaught and appear nowhere - every past frame uses szedl/szla/szlo or a noun subject. Distractor sets are all pool-legal: ulicy is TAUGHT <- b2_fem_soft [135], rzeka/wode/most/park/las are all taught nouns, and dobry/duzy/nowy are trunk_adjectives_a1. No fabricated form appears in any choice list.

intro.title: A new preposition, and a case you have had since A1
intro.title_pl: przez park · przez most · przez las
intro.body:
przez is new. What follows it is not: przez takes the Accusative, the case you have been putting on things since mam kawę.

It means through something, or across it — the path taken, not the destination. Idę do parku is where I end up. Idę przez park is what I go through on the way.

So przez answers a different question from do. do + Genitive names the end of the journey; przez + Accusative names the middle of it, and the two sit in one sentence without arguing: Idę przez park do sklepu.
intro.body_pl: przez + biernik — przez park do sklepu

rows: I'm walking through the park to the shop

intro.title: You cannot see the case on park or most — here is where you can
intro.body:
park, most and las are masculine things and miasto is neuter. None of them changes in the Accusative, so every example on the last slide hid the case completely.

Put a feminine noun after przez and it appears at once: przez ulicę, not przez ulica. It is the same -ę you have put on kawa, herbata and książka since your ninth lesson, and it is the proof that the Accusative is really there.

These two are the only nouns in this unit that change shape.
intro.body_pl: ulica → przez ulicę · rzeka → przez rzekę

rows: through the park — no visible change
across the bridge — no visible change
through the town — no visible change

intro.title: The verb that has been waiting for this preposition
intro.body:
When you learned pójść, wejść and dojść, one prefix was held back: prze-. It was held back because przejść has one everyday use — przejść przez ulicę, to cross the street — and przez did not exist yet. It does now.

prze- welds onto the same stem table you already read pójść off. Nothing here is built; it is read.

Watch the masculine and feminine past, which behave exactly as poszedłem and poszłam do: the szedł piece appears in the masculine and vanishes in the feminine.

intro.title: The same prefix on the vehicle stem
intro.body:
By car, bus or bike it is przejechać, and it sits on the stem table you read pojechać off. The past is the ordinary -ać past you have had since A2, so there is nothing awkward in it at all.

przejść is on foot. przejechać is in or on something. That is the only difference, and it is the same split as iść and jechać, which you have kept apart since A1.

rows: he drove through / she drove through
he or she will drive through

intro.title: przez also says for how long
intro.body:
The second job costs you nothing new. Put a stretch of time after przez and it says how long something went on for: przez rok, przez tydzień, przez dwa lata, przez dwie godziny.

Still the Accusative, and rok, tydzień and dzień are masculine things, so not one of them changes. dwa lata is the counted form you already use for age.

cały is the one new word: cały dzień, cały tydzień, cały rok — the whole day, the whole week, the whole year.
intro.body_pl: przez rok · przez tydzień · przez dwa lata · przez cały dzień

rows: no — the counted form from Mam czterdzieści cztery lata

intro.title: And przez says who did it
intro.body:
You know how to say a thing is in a finished state: Sklep jest zamknięty. List jest napisany.

Name the person who did it with przez, and the person goes into the Accusative like everything else after this preposition: List jest napisany przez tatę. Książka jest napisana przez mamę.

English uses by here, and by is also how English says przez autobusem — it is not. Travelling by bus is jadę autobusem, the Instrumental with no preposition at all, which you have had since A2. przez is only ever the person or thing that did the deed.
intro.body_pl: napisany przez tatę · napisana przez mamę

rows: the letter is written by dad
the book is written by mum

quiz.prompt: Idę ___ park. (I'm walking through the park)
quiz.explain: The park is what I go through, not where I end up. do parku would be the destination.
The Accusative, exactly as after mam. ulica is the dictionary form and ulicy is the form you use after w and o.

quiz.prompt: Idę ___ sklepu. (I'm going to the shop)
quiz.explain: The shop is the destination, so do and the Genitive. przez would mean you walked through the shop and out the other side.
Feminine, so the Accusative -ę shows. wodę is the right ending on the wrong word.

quiz.prompt: Byłem w pracy przez ___ dzień. (the whole day)
quiz.explain: cały is whole or entire. dzień is a masculine thing, so the Accusative does not change it.
Mama is she, so the feminine third person — and the szedł piece drops, exactly as in poszła.
He, and in a vehicle. przeszedł would mean he walked across.

quiz.prompt: Potem ___ przez park. (I will cross, on foot)
quiz.explain: Read off the same table as pójdę. pójdę is go, przejdę is go across.
The person who did it takes przez and the Accusative. tatę is the same form you use in Mam tatę.
las is forest, and being a masculine thing it does not change after przez.

quiz.prompt: Studenci byli tam przez ___ lata. (two years)
quiz.explain: lata is the 2-4 counted form, so it needs dwa. From five up it would be pięć lat.
She, in a vehicle, in the past. przejechałam would be I, a woman speaking about herself.
